## What's changed

- Match subtitle batch edits by language, subtitle kind, and hearing-impaired/SDH identity, independent of stream order and default/forced flags.
- Detect SDH from source subtitle metadata descriptions and preserve default and forced flags independently.
- Sample 15 frames at 30% and 70% of video sources for crop detection, with CUDA scaling when available and CPU fallback.
- Wait for probing, preview creation, and crop analysis to finish before opening the source workspace.
- Estimate encode progress from frames and FPS if FFmpeg omits timestamps, and retain/update bitrate when FFmpeg reports it intermittently.
